### Linear Attention 的状态不是 Transformer KV 的同义词
### 多 Agent Cascade 需要跨 Channel 的 Influence Graph
### Whitening 的收益取决于 Gradient Spectrum 所在 Regime
### Task State Alignment 是每次 Dispatch 的前置条件
### Sparse Keyframe Prediction 是 Dense Rollout 之前的 Planner Branch
### Pre-guard 可以前移，但最终 Authority 不能前移给 Draft Model
### Index Update 可以借用 Search I/O Stall，但不能借走 Freshness Authority
### Distributed Model Merge 需要把 Replication 与 Merge Strategy 分层
### Filter Threshold 必须绑定 Compute-to-Unique-Data Regime
### 反馈预算必须绑定样本粒度与可观测不确定性
### Reverse KL 会把“找到高奖励”收缩成单一路径
### 可组合 Prompt 也是 Versioned Supply-chain Artifact
### Model Switch 不能把 Weight State 与 Request State 混成一次迁移
### 可编程 Skill 需要输入、状态与副作用契约
### Security Agent 的评估必须绑定 Tool Trace 与 Deterministic Predicate

no_change_existing_coverage.main_body_anchor: ## 可靠传输与背压
no_change_existing_coverage.existing_proposition: Durable diagnostic evidence requires structured identity, bounded buffering, retention/deletion policy and an acknowledgement boundary; ordinary logs remain a best-effort fallback.

no_change_existing_coverage.main_body_anchor: ## Prompt Injection 与 Tool Boundary
no_change_existing_coverage.existing_proposition: Retrieved content is untrusted data; privacy/exfiltration sensors do not own authorization, and high-risk release falls back to deterministic policy and review.

no_change_existing_coverage.main_body_anchor: ## Relevance 不等于 Sufficient Context
no_change_existing_coverage.existing_proposition: Parametric belief, retrieved evidence, conflict handling and abstention are separate states; a calibrated policy may retrieve, answer or abstain without treating confidence as truth.

no_change_existing_coverage.main_body_anchor: ### 从经验 confidence threshold 到有条件的 Risk Contract
no_change_existing_coverage.existing_proposition: Cascade routing commits or escalates only under a held-out calibrated error/risk contract and explicit cost/SLO objective; heuristic routing remains the fallback when assumptions fail.

no_change_existing_coverage.main_body_anchor: ## 平均值、切片与不确定性
no_change_existing_coverage.existing_proposition: Coverage claims must bind calibration assumptions and the entire multi-stage evaluation identity; per-stage confidence cannot be multiplied into a pipeline guarantee without a joint contract.

no_change_existing_coverage.main_body_anchor: ### Data Attribution 本身也需要对抗性 Provenance Contract
no_change_existing_coverage.existing_proposition: Data attribution is a versioned estimator with causal/provenance assumptions, not per-example truth; decisions require controlled counterfactual evidence and rollback.

no_change_existing_coverage.main_body_anchor: ## Variable-length Batch 让并行计划成为 Runtime State
no_change_existing_coverage.existing_proposition: Parallelism plans are runtime state; a topology/role switch must preserve optimizer, parameter, RNG and in-flight communication identity and pay an explicit transition/rollback cost.

no_change_existing_coverage.main_body_anchor: ### Benchmark 生成器也会塑造被评估的任务人口
no_change_existing_coverage.existing_proposition: Generated benchmarks must version reference material, task population, answer/solution artifact and independent validation; generated ground truth remains evidence to audit, not authority.

no_change_existing_coverage.main_body_anchor: ### 从统一保留到 workload-aware eviction
no_change_existing_coverage.existing_proposition: Semantic utility may propose retention, but cache runtime owns eviction and fallback; model/workload revision, budget and quality regression tests are part of cache identity.

no_change_existing_coverage.main_body_anchor: ## Routing、Placement 与 Autoscaling
no_change_existing_coverage.existing_proposition: Routing jointly considers request state, quality/cost/SLO, locality and device capacity; edge/cloud placement is conditional and falls back to a fixed route when calibration or transfer cost is uncertain.

no_change_existing_coverage.main_body_anchor: ### Memory 粒度必须分层，不能用一个 Summary 同时承担证据与画像
no_change_existing_coverage.existing_proposition: Condensed memory is a derived view whose identity, loss boundary and source replay path must remain separate from exact episodic evidence.

no_change_existing_coverage.main_body_anchor: ### Learned Security Sensor 与 Reference Monitor 必须分层
no_change_existing_coverage.existing_proposition: A latent learned detector is a policy-bound sensor; deterministic authorization/reference monitoring owns the commit and provides fail-closed fallback.

no_change_existing_coverage.main_body_anchor: ## Memory Write 是高风险决策
no_change_existing_coverage.existing_proposition: Experience is admitted with provenance, transfer tests, expiry and rollback; locally successful traces do not become reusable facts or procedures automatically.

no_change_existing_coverage.main_body_anchor: ## 扩展 Agent 数量之前，先测量 Coordination Tax
no_change_existing_coverage.existing_proposition: Delegation must beat a matched single-agent baseline under joint quality, cost and latency, while identity and final commit authority remain explicit.

no_change_existing_coverage.main_body_anchor: ### 静态 Mixture 到版本化 Data Control Plane
no_change_existing_coverage.existing_proposition: Sampling/mixture schedules are versioned training control state and must be evaluated against model progress, data utility and distribution drift.

no_change_existing_coverage.main_body_anchor: ### Agent Privacy 必须对整条 Trajectory 记账
no_change_existing_coverage.existing_proposition: Privacy and utility are evaluated across the full observable trajectory and attacker model; a diagnostic benchmark does not grant a deployment guarantee.

no_change_existing_coverage.main_body_anchor: ### Task State Alignment 是每次 Dispatch 的前置条件
no_change_existing_coverage.existing_proposition: Each handoff resolves the current stage, evidence, constraints and target interface before dispatch; local convergence does not prove open-system delivery or authority.

no_change_existing_coverage.main_body_anchor: ## Capability Access Control 可以前移到训练状态
no_change_existing_coverage.existing_proposition: Progressive autonomy is a calibrated, revocable capability budget owned by policy, not a model-derived trust score; uncertain or drifting preferences fall back to approval.

no_change_existing_coverage.main_body_anchor: ### 长 RTT 跨域链路需要显式的远端速率预算
no_change_existing_coverage.existing_proposition: Geo-distributed overlap depends on latency, serialization, topology and dependency slack; simulation results cannot replace measured congestion/failure evidence.

no_change_existing_coverage.main_body_anchor: ## Verification 与 Aggregation
no_change_existing_coverage.existing_proposition: Consensus stopping consumes a calibrated evidence/compute budget; correlated agents and violated independence assumptions require escalation or a single verified path.

no_change_existing_coverage.main_body_anchor: ### Judge 只能提案，Evidence Gate 才能 Override
no_change_existing_coverage.existing_proposition: LLM judges are versioned, calibrated sensors; evidence acquisition and deterministic/outcome verification retain final authority.

no_change_existing_coverage.main_body_anchor: ### KV 的误差坐标与 Admission 必须同时可见
no_change_existing_coverage.existing_proposition: KV pruning/compression is admitted only with model/layer/position/budget identity, quality error tracking and a FullKV/recompute fallback.

no_change_existing_coverage.main_body_anchor: ### 视觉逼真与三维一致性是两份不同证据
no_change_existing_coverage.existing_proposition: Visual quality and physics-faithful transition evidence are separate; invariants may verify a bounded branch but do not replace environment truth or closed-loop correction.

no_change_existing_coverage.main_body_anchor: ### Benchmark 本身也要经过 Adversarial Audit
no_change_existing_coverage.existing_proposition: Agent attack/defense benchmarks version the threat model, environment, tool effects and false-positive/negative slices; benchmark success is not a safety guarantee.

no_change_existing_coverage.main_body_anchor: ## World Model 的物理评测要落到定律与参数
no_change_existing_coverage.existing_proposition: A reference world model is itself a versioned measurement artifact whose coverage and error must be validated before unmatched behavior is labeled hallucination.

no_change_existing_coverage.main_body_anchor: ## Supply-chain Integrity
no_change_existing_coverage.existing_proposition: AI artifacts require lifecycle provenance, dependency/producer identity, promotion evidence and verification; a bill of materials is an input to assurance, not proof by itself.

no_change_existing_coverage.main_body_anchor: ### 先验证 Benchmark 的 Reference Artifact，再比较 Agent
no_change_existing_coverage.existing_proposition: Computer-use evaluation needs a versioned executable world, deterministic predicates and replayable state; a benchmark artifact cannot substitute for live-world coverage.

no_change_existing_coverage.main_body_anchor: ### Dynamic Benchmark 是一条持续运行的生命周期
no_change_existing_coverage.existing_proposition: Contamination resistance is a lifecycle of provenance, refresh, exposure detection and calibration; a static hidden set is not durable protection.

no_change_existing_coverage.main_body_anchor: ## Full fine-tuning 与 parameter-efficient adaptation
no_change_existing_coverage.existing_proposition: Full fine-tuning and LoRA expose different trainable parameter subspaces; selecting a hybrid mask is a budgeted, versioned adaptation choice, so Hybrid-LoRA's saliency implementation does not create a new system owner.

no_change_existing_coverage.main_body_anchor: ### Tool Exposure Reward 必须扣除随机候选集优势
no_change_existing_coverage.existing_proposition: Tool-selection evidence must be corrected against the chance baseline induced by the exposed candidate set; a raw success or retrieval score cannot establish tool-policy quality.

no_change_existing_coverage.main_body_anchor: ### 从 Raw Score 到可定位、可校准的 Claim Sensor
no_change_existing_coverage.existing_proposition: Internal consistency is a versioned claim sensor rather than truth; external evidence, deterministic checks or outcome verification retain authority, with abstention/escalation when the sensor is uncalibrated.

no_change_existing_coverage.main_body_anchor: ### Correction
no_change_existing_coverage.existing_proposition: Inference-time correction keeps provisional regions mutable, commits them only under an explicit budget and confidence boundary, and falls back to the unrefined/full generation path when correction evidence is insufficient.

no_change_existing_coverage.main_body_anchor: ### 固定预算要先分配信息责任，再选择具体 Token
no_change_existing_coverage.existing_proposition: A fixed multimodal token budget first allocates temporal and spatial information responsibility, then selects tokens; allocation drift is monitored and can fall back to denser or full-token processing.

no_change_existing_coverage.main_body_anchor: ### 固定预算要先分配信息责任，再选择具体 Token
no_change_existing_coverage.existing_proposition: Current Ch23 already makes spatial/temporal information allocation, position identity, compression-version identity and dense/full-token fallback explicit. AQuaUI adds a GUI-specific quadtree implementation and tested evidence, but no additional durable owner or proposition.
